posts.meta_description:
shereenlovebug on April 30, 2026: "We’re never gonna survive 💅 
@natasha.poonawalla for @kingstrust in New York! 
With @rheakapoor @iambidipto_ @sanyakapoor 

Repost/On this Spring evening in New York, @natasha.poonawalla wears a custom warm ivory muga silk sari ensemble by @arpita__mehta , hand-embroidered with Kantha.

Kantha, an ancient, eco-conscious embroidery tradition from Bengal, where old saris and dhotis were repurposed into layered textiles. In this ensemble, that philosophy is preserved, bringing together fragments of lived histories with a fresh, contemporary perspective.

The look is completed with custom earrings by @shriparamanijewels in collaboration with Arpita Mehta, paired with traditional Indian jadau jewellery.

Navratan bajubandh (right) - @themedjewellerybypoojanigam
Hair pin - @jagdishjewellerschandigarh
Emerald choker, emerald earrings, navratan bajubandh and peacock ring - @archanaaggarwalofficial 
Croc kada - @rejagems 
Tiger kada and peacock kada - @thehouseoframbhajos 
Polki and ruby ring - @raniwala1881
custom clutch @meera_mahadevia
Draped by @a__patel".

posts.meta_description:
shereenlovebug on May 4, 2026: "SUBODH GUPTA X ROBERT WUN for ANANYA BIRLA #met2026 

Crafting the Ordinary into the Extraordinary. #fashionisart 

Using his signature stainless steel, Gupta has crafted what is both a disguise, obscuring the wearer’s identity, and a visage
of foreboding strength. The work sends mixed signals: the wearer who dons this piece becomes a super
hero yet one who comes out of the humble beginnings of the common household. 

Extending this idea, Robert Wun reinterprets the codes of everyday workwear, pushing the ordinary further into the realm of the extraordinary. What we pass by without notice are reimagined to their maximum impact. 

In @robertwun Couture
Sculpture by @subodhguptastudio
Earrings: @mehtasons1931 
Necklace: Ananya’s own
Photographer: @rafaelpavarotti_
Creative Direction and Styling: @rheakapoor
Styled with @shereenlovebug and @sanyakapoor
Creative consultant for Ms. Birla @chandnijmodha 
Make-up: @loveleen_makeuphair
Hair: @marissa.marino 
On set seamstress: @modernstitchtailoring
Nails: @angelsnailz 

#metgala #metgala2026".
